Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our discussion, the next step would be a technical deep-dive to align on networking, VPC peering options (or on-prem connectivity), and IAM/secret-handling for the Redwood Private deployment. Recommended attendees: MedByte infra engineer, procurement (for SOW/timeline questions), and one security contact. From our side I'll bring Kimberly (solutions lead) and Neha (SE, networking).

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Quick goals & success criteria (5m)
- Network topology & connectivity options (10m)
- IAM, key management, and audit logs (10m)
- Next steps / procurement timeline (10m)

Can you suggest two 1-hour windows next week that work for engineering + procurement? If helpful, we can send a calendar poll.

Attachments: Draft_SOW_MedByte.pdf (high-level), DeepDive_Agenda_v1.docx

Thanks —
